description: This file defines the Popup_Picker class for handling contact selection popups, address processing, and merging in SuiteCRM, including methods for generating address forms, list views, and handling user interactions within contact popups.

classes.name: Popup_Picker
classes.description: Class managing contact popup interactions, address forms, and merge functionalities in SuiteCRM.
